status: UNSET pins are the point: nothing in the repository records the sha256 or the exact size of the image archive, of the signed boot GOP or of the swtpm sources, so the propimage_apps stage refuses (PIN_UNSET:<role>) until a person who holds the real object fills them in from the object itself and commits them. The stage never reads a pin from a server and never runs an unpinned object. STATUS 2026-11-15.
